DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about opening an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社が指定した銀行は分かりますが、支店も指定か不明です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 支店指定の不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I know which bank my company specified, but not whether it specified a branch too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether a particular branch is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書面の案内はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀行名だけです。口頭で支店を聞いたか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 書面と曖昧な記憶を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: They only name the bank. I cannot remember whether I was told a branch verbally.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the written instructions from your uncertain memory. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先へ確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you check with your employer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。ここで近い支店を選べば必ずよいとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先へ指定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will not assume that choosing a nearby branch here will definitely be acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the requirements with your employer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の準備資料も案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can also explain which personal documents to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞きたいです。給与受取の目的と本人資料を分けて準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人資料の準備を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like that. I will prepare separately for the purpose of receiving wages and for my identity documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask which personal documents to prepare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開設は確認後に進めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you proceed with opening the account after checking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。会社の希望と銀行の申込条件を両方確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社と銀行の条件を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check both the company's requirements and the bank's application conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the company's and the bank's conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 今日は開設準備の相談として承ります。会社の指定を確認してから担当へお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Today we will treat this as advice on preparing to open an account. Check the company's requirements before coming to the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the display in the sales area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 見本袋には三個の絵があります。商品も三個入りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見本の絵と個数を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The sample bag shows three pieces. Does the actual product contain three too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the sample illustration and the number of pieces. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見本は説明用です。販売品を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sample is for explanation. Let us check the product for sale.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 実際の個数表示を見たいです。袋の大きさだけでは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 販売品の表示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to see the actual quantity label. I will not judge just from the bag's size.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to see the label on the product for sale. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは五個入りです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三人へ一個ずつ渡すので、残る二個の保存も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 人数と余剰分を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will give one each to three people, so I will also consider how to store the two left over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Consider the number of recipients and the surplus. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一個ずつの販売もあります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では個別包装の三個を比較したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個別販売を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I would like to compare buying three individually wrapped pieces.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare individually sold products. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの三個の合計は四百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: These three cost four hundred yen altogether.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予算内です。五個袋を買わずこの三個にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要三個と合計で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: That is within my budget. I will choose these three instead of buying the bag of five.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose based on the three you need and the total price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 個別の三個を四百円でご案内します。見本袋は説明用のまま残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will provide the three individual pieces for four hundred yen. The sample bag will remain here for explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the way to an exit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 疲れたので、出発した入口へ戻らず東口で迎えを頼みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 戻らず別出口を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am tired, so rather than return to the entrance I started from, I would like someone to pick me up at the east exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a different exit rather than returning to the original entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 迎えの方へ変更を伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you told the person picking you up about the change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。通れる出口か確認してから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確認後の迎え変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I will contact them after checking that the exit is accessible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will change the pickup arrangements after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 東口はこの道で行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can reach the east exit along this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車が停まれる場所も、公園出口とは別に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出口と駐車場所を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would also like to check where a car can stop, separately from the park exit itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the exit from the parking location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出口の外の案内をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the information outside the exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 路上待機を頼まず、指定の駐車場へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定駐車場を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not ask them to wait on the road. I will contact them about using the designated car park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the person picking you up about the designated car park. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中にベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is a bench along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこで休み、迎えの返事を待ってから東口へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩後に合流返答で進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will rest there and wait for their reply before continuing to the east exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will rest and proceed after receiving the pickup person's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この道のベンチで休んでください。東口は先にあります。車との合流は外の指定場所で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please rest on the bench along this path. The east exit is farther ahead. Confirm where to meet the car at the designated location outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらへ向かわれますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私はＡ駅、友人はＢ駅です。途中まで一緒に行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別目的地の共同区間を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to Station A, and my friend to Station B. Can we travel together for part of the journey?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which portion you can share when going to different destinations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの行程を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check each of your routes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ終点へ行く二人とは扱わず、分かれる駅を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 分岐駅を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do not treat us as two people going to the same terminus. I would like to know at which station we split up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask at which station your routes separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この便ならＣ駅で分かれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this service, you split up at Station C.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そこで乗換えの時間が短すぎないかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗換時間を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please also tell me whether the transfer time there would be too short.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the transfer time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次便を待つ方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can also wait for the following service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 急がず次を待ちます。友人の券を自分が持ち去らないよう分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次便と各自券の保持を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will wait for the next one without rushing. We will separate our tickets so I do not take my friend's away with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the following service and ensure each person keeps their own ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 券はそれぞれありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you each have a ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。各自の券とＣ駅の乗場を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各券と乗場を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We will check our respective tickets and the boarding locations at Station C.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match each ticket with the boarding location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: Ｃ駅まで同じ便、その後は各行先の案内でお進みください。次便の乗場もこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take the same service as far as Station C, then follow the information for your separate destinations. The boarding location for the following service is also shown here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書のご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出した後に返してもらいたいです。こちらで返却を頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 提出後返却を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like it returned after submitting it. Can I request its return here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want the certificate returned after submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の扱いを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the policy with the organization receiving it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 発行窓口と返却を決める所は別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発行と返却の担当を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the issuing counter and the place that decides whether to return it are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish responsibility for issuing it and returning it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 何を証明する書類ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: What does the document need to certify?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所です。今の指定は原本ですが、返却について書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目的と原本指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My address. The current instructions require an original, but say nothing about returning it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the purpose and the requirement for an original. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な発行条件を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the necessary issuance conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: コピーで代用するのではなく、提出先へ返却方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自己代用せず提出先へ聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than substitute a photocopy myself, I will ask the receiving organization how to get the original returned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the receiving organization instead of substituting a copy yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to proceed with the application now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 条件を確かめてから、必要な通数を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件後に通数を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will decide how many copies I need after checking the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide the number of copies after checking the conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発行と提出後の返却を分けてご確認ください。今日は必要な記載と通数の案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check issuance and return after submission separately. Today we will give you information about the required details and number of copies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この欄のお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about this field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一日に三回と書きましたが、一回の長さを聞く欄ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 回数と継続時間の欄を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote three times a day, but is this field asking how long each episode lasts?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the fields for frequency and duration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時間と回数を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will ask about duration and frequency separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一回は五分ほどです。回数は昨日三回でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一回長さと昨日回数を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Each episode lasts about five minutes. It happened three times yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the duration of one episode and yesterday's frequency. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 昨日だけの記録ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is a record for yesterday only, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。毎日三回続くとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毎日の状態と決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I am not saying it happens three times every day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not describe it as necessarily happening every day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 他に変わったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have there been any other changes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一回です。その違いも記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本日の違いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has happened once today. Please record that difference too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain today's difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診療担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass this on to the medical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正確な時刻はメモで確認し、分からない所は推測しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不明時刻を推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check my notes for the exact times and will not guess what I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not guess unknown times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 継続約五分、昨日三回、今日一回として引き継ぎます。時刻不明の部分も区別してお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will report that it lasts around five minutes, happened three times yesterday and once today. Please also distinguish the times you do not know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような連絡ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of contact did you receive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人から、口座を使わせれば報酬を払うと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 報酬付き口座貸与要求を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An acquaintance said they would pay me if I let them use my bank account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a request to lend your account in exchange for payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you given them any information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。知り合いだから条件を読まず承諾はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 情報未提供で承諾しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I will not agree without reading the conditions just because I know them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not provided information and will not agree. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 依頼の内容を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このメッセージです。カードも渡すよう書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カード要求の原文を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is the message. It also says to hand over my card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the original message asking for your card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を残してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。お金を受け取ったことも、カードを貸したこともありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未受領未貸与を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I have neither accepted any money nor lent my card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Clearly state that you have accepted nothing and lent nothing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ経緯を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the circumstances to the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相手と争いに行かず、断り方と相談先を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対面で争わず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I do not want to go and argue with them. I would like advice on refusing and where to seek help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Seek advice without going to confront the person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未承諾、未受領、情報未提供の相談として担当へ引き継ぎます。口座の実際の状態も銀行へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer this as a case where you have not agreed, accepted payment or provided information. You can also check the actual state of your account with the bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you sending the parcel again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 戻った荷物を別の友人へ送りたいです。前のラベルは残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返送箱の別宛発送を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to send the returned parcel to a different friend. The old label is still attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending a returned parcel to a different recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい宛先が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: You will need a new address label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の番号で届いた扱いにはせず、新しく相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧番号を新発送と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not treat it as delivered under the old tracking number. I would like to arrange a new shipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the old tracking number from the new shipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身に変更はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一つ取り出しました。前の内容欄とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内容変更を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I removed one item. They are different from the previous contents description.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Declare the change in contents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱の状態も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the condition of the box too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 破れがあるので、使い直せるか見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱の損傷確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has a tear. Please check whether it can be reused.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the damage to the box to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しい内容と宛先で準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will prepare it with the new contents and address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 旧ラベルの扱いも確認し、番号を混ぜず記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧ラベル記録を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will also check what to do with the old label and keep separate records without mixing up the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the old and new label records separate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 別の宛先への新しい発送として確認します。中身と箱を見直してからラベルをご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check this as a new shipment to a different address. Please inspect the contents and box before preparing the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求書と後のメールで金額が違います。どちらか未確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 異なる二金額を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The amount on the invoice differs from the later email. I have not confirmed which is correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the two different amounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。安い方を勝手に選んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未送金で勝手に選ばない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I have not simply chosen the lower amount myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not transferred the money or chosen an amount yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡の日時を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check when each notice arrived.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 請求書は昨日、メールは今朝です。訂正と書いてあるかも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知順と訂正表記を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The invoice was yesterday and the email this morning. I will also check whether it says correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the order of the notices and whether a correction is stated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 依頼元の既知の連絡先で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please verify with the requester using a contact method you already know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。口座が同じでも、金額が確定したとは思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 依頼元へ金額照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Even if the account is the same, I will not assume the amount is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the amount with the requester. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返事後に入力を見直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can review the input after receiving their reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確定した金額と根拠の返事を残し、その後に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定根拠を保持して送る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the confirmed amount and the reply supporting it, then send the money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the confirmation supporting the amount before transferring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの資料は保持してください。銀行では請求内容の正誤を決めず、依頼元確認後に振込を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please retain both documents. The bank will not decide which invoice is correct; we will guide the transfer after you check with the requester.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私がまとめて払います。友人の会員カードもあるので扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一括支払と二カードを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will pay for everything together. I also have my friend's membership card and would like to ask how to handle it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about one combined payment and two membership cards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象と条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check eligibility and the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚見せればポイントも二倍とは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 重複ポイントを決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not assume showing two cards would earn double points.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not assume points can be duplicated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品は分けたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Would you like the items kept separate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋は別です。誰の商品かを示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品所有と袋を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Separate bags, please. I will identify whose items are whose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish ownership of the items and separate bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 会計方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the checkout method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会員の扱いが別会計なら、先に説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計条件を先に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: If membership rules require separate payments, please explain that first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about checkout conditions in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この場面では一件に使えるカードは一枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: In this situation only one card can be used per transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では私の一枚でまとめます。友人も了承しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同行者同意で一カードを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will use just my card and pay together. My friend agrees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose one card with your companion's agreement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一枚のカードと一括支払で会計します。商品は二人の袋へ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will use one card and one combined payment, and put your items into separate bags for each of you.
